mechanism_of_action: Complex carbohydrate drug that binds to galectin 3.
primary_endpoint: Change in HVPG from baseline at 1 year.
efficacy_outcome: Mean change in HVPG was -0.39 mm Hg with 2 mg/kg and -0.24 mm Hg with 8 mg/kg, versus +0.19 mm Hg with placebo; p=1.000 for both comparisons.
safety_signal: Serious adverse events: 10/53 (2 mg/kg), 16/54 (8 mg/kg), and 12/54 (placebo); deaths: 1, 0, and 0, respectively.
